Summary of SCFA data (SCFA concentration)

This study evaluates Plasma SCFA measurements for project Demo dataset 1. Short-chain fatty acids were quantified using GC-FID and normalized to SCFA concentration.

Methods

The procedure for SCFA extraction is based on the protocol described by Zhao et al. [-@zhao2006rapid]. The material was resuspended in MilliQ-grade water and homogenized using an MP Bio FastPrep system for 1 minute at 4.0 m/s. The suspensions were acidified to a final pH of 2.0 using 5M HCl. After acidification, the suspensions were incubated and centrifuged at 10,000 RPM to separate the supernatant. The resulting supernatant was spiked with 2-ethylbutyric acid to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM.
